purpose: Define a fail-closed historical availability rule for COT edge research without requiring individual Friday publication proof for every normal week.

official_basis.cftc_about_cot: CFTC states that since 1992 the COT report is published on the third business day after the as-of date.
official_basis.historical_special_announcements: Known exceptional publication disruptions and delays are recorded in the CFTC historical special announcements archive.

normal_week.rationale: Deliberately later than the ordinary third-business-day release to create a strong anti-look-ahead buffer.

documented_exception.fallback: WITHHOLD if actual publication date is not proven

shutdown_2018_2019.treatment: WITHHOLD until individual actual publication dates or equally strong official execution evidence are proven
